card.name: Unit word right after a number
card.fires_on: The unit word (mg, ng, mcg, square) right after a number, just before a slash or a following "miles" or "/dL". It is strongest where a rate or concentration like mg/dL or ng/mL is being written.

modes.label: Concentration or rate unit
modes.description: The first part of a compound unit such as mg/dL, ng/mL, mg/hr or ng/kg after a number.

modes.label: Other unit after number
modes.description: A unit word such as square or years after a number in a non-concentration setting.
modes.example: From Sharkey it would take 18<< square>> miles, leaving 2465

card.writes: It promotes odd slash- and measure-like tokens and suppresses "or" in several languages, so it favors continuing a unit rather than an "or" alternative.
card.plain: It fires on the unit that follows a number, like the mg in 9 mg/dL, when a slash and a per-unit are about to come.
